objectives.description: Create orchestrate-recap.sh with --write and speak modes
Smoke test both modes by hand; run lint-shellcheck.sh

approaches_tried.approach: Tested orchestrate-recap.sh standalone from the source store using DEPLOY_ROOT_GUARD_SELF_CORRECT=1
approaches_tried.reason: common_repo_root() ignores the guard's self-corrected REPO_ROOT and recomputes a pure 2-levels-up path, landing inside agent-system/extensions/specs/ instead of the real specs/ -- this script is not one of the few self-correcting scripts (sync-manifest-scripts.sh, check-extension-docs.sh) that explicitly use $REPO_ROOT instead of common_repo_root(), so it correctly refuses/misresolves from the source store by the same convention as its sibling orchestrate-*.sh scripts

approaches_tried.approach: Built a minimal fake .claude/scripts/ deploy tree under the scratchpad directory (copying orchestrate-recap.sh, deploy-root-guard.sh, lib/common.sh, lib/runtime-file-patterns.sh) to smoke-test both modes without a real deploy
approaches_tried.reason: deploy-root-guard.sh's case match on the parent directory name (.claude) is satisfied structurally, and common_repo_root resolves correctly 2 levels up to the fake root; every Phase 1 smoke scenario (--help, write+round-trip with apostrophe/double-quote, TTS_ENABLED=0, no-file generic sentence, recompose from a fixture .return-meta-multi-*.json, piper-absent, malformed-meta-file) passed with exit 0 and correct text
